title: Keep It Saucy! - Healthy treats for pets and people - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago Healthy Parfait for Humans. (Photo By Margo Schwab/Special for Times of San Diego) They are our beloved best friends, so today’s column also includes a healthy recipe for our beloved furry ones.
Healthy pet treats 25 minutes
Healthy pet treats. (Photo By Margo Schwab/Special for Times of San Diego) Ingredients: Organic flour, egg, canned organic chicken, or tuna or salmon, optional for dogs, unsweetened organic peanut butter with no Xylitol; optional for cats, add catnip.
Tools needed: Cooking pan, parchment paper, mixing bowl, spoon, spatula, plate.
Prep and serve: Preheat oven to 325, in a bowl mix 1 egg with ¼ cup organic flour, 6 ounces chicken (salmon or tuna is an option), mix well, optional add 2 T peanut butter no Xylitol for dogs, or 3 pinches of catnip for cats, place teaspoons of mixture on parchment paper on cooking pan in oven, monitor and bake up to 16 minutes, let cool, I recommend feeding treats outside if possible for no mess!
Healthy parfait for humans 10 minutes
Ingredients: Yogurt, frozen bananas, fresh raspberries, unsweetened chocolate chips, organic cooked beets, monkfruit, oat milk.
Tools needed: Blender, spatula, spoon, serving flute.
Prep and serve: Per person, blend 1 frozen banana, 2 small, cooked beets or 1 large, 1/3 cup yogurt, 1 t monk fruit, pour half into a flute, place half of raspberries, pour the rest of the blender in, top with a circle of raspberries and unsweetened chocolate chips.
P.S.: I add protein powder to the blender mixture for added health.
Enjoy!
